Sky Radar: Live Flights

Track flights worldwide with real-time data and an interactive map.

Sky Radar is a powerful yet easy-to-use flight tracking app that lets you follow live flights around the world. View aircraft in real time, explore routes, check flight details, and discover airports nearby, all in one clean and intuitive app.

Live Flight Tracking on Map

See flights as they happen on an interactive world map.
Sky Radar allows you to track live flights worldwide, view aircraft positions in real time, follow flight paths and routes, and explore global air traffic with clarity.

Real-Time Flight Details

Access accurate and up-to-date flight information, including flight number and airline, departure and arrival airports, scheduled and estimated times, aircraft type, altitude, speed, and current flight status.
Stay informed at every stage of the journey.

Search Flights by Route

Quickly find flights between two airports.
Search by departure and arrival locations, view available flights instantly, and access detailed route and timing information.
This feature is ideal for planning or tracking specific flights.

Discover Flights Nearby

Find flights and airports around your location.
Search nearby flights within a custom radius, discover local air traffic in real time, and view nearby airports and active routes.
Perfect for travelers and aviation enthusiasts.

Search Airports by Country

Explore airports around the world with ease.
Find airports by country, view airport locations on the map, and access airport-related flight activity quickly.
A useful tool for global exploration and travel planning.

Clear Data and Visual Insights

Sky Radar organizes flight data into clean and easy-to-read views.
Enjoy smooth map interactions, clear flight summaries, intuitive layouts, and fast access to essential information.

Simple and Modern Design

Designed with clarity and usability in mind.
Sky Radar features a clean interface, smooth performance, responsive maps, and easy navigation suitable for all users.

Who Is Sky Radar For

Sky Radar is ideal for travelers tracking upcoming flights, aviation enthusiasts, airport spotters, frequent flyers, and anyone curious about live air traffic.

Why Choose Sky Radar

Live flight tracking worldwide
Real-time flight data
Route-based flight search
Nearby flights and airports
Global airport exploration
All-in-one flight tracking experience

Important Notice

Sky Radar provides flight tracking and informational data for reference purposes only.
Flight data may be delayed or incomplete depending on data sources and coverage.

This app is not intended for air traffic control or operational decision-making.
Always rely on official airline and airport sources for critical travel information.
